title: Using the playground
description: Run and edit a greeting, then use variables to query a small herd.

steps.title: Run and edit
steps.description: Run the greeting query. Change Sam in the query to your name and run again. In schema.ts, change Hello to Welcome to edit the response.

steps.title: Explore a schema
steps.description: Run Tall giraffes, then All giraffes. Change minimumHeight in Variables to filter the herd. Open schema.graphql to inspect the field and argument types.
